about: Octatrack modules listed before 17 November 2026 that do not yet name their CPU price (resources.cpuPrice, docs/MODULE_PERFORMANCE.md). Every other module must name one. This list only shrinks: npm run modules:check refuses an id that is not on it at the pull request's base or that was listed from 17 November 2026, and an id whose module names a price. Measure, write resources.cpuPrice, then delete the module's line here in the same pull request.
